1cd4073be3.q: What is the hourly wage bleed concept mentioned in the FreeUp Founder time audit?
1cd4073be3.a: The hourly wage bleed is about putting a dollar amount to the time spent on something that can be eliminated, delegated, or automated. It makes the abstract concept of 'time is money' concrete and actionable.
